title: gilia humillima
intro: Gilia humillima, commonly known as the 'Little Gilia', is a flowering plant species belonging to the Polemoniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as wounds, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Gilia humillima include its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it useful in treating anxiety and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Gilia humillima include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
